text:
Mia (Product Design): Hey—drafting a short deprecation banner for the legacy endpoint (v1.2). Want quick microcopy + a11y + i18n checks. Screenshot uploaded in thread.

Mia (Product Design): Context: We’ll stop serving v1.2 in ~60 days. Users should migrate to v2 (same API surface, better heuristics). Banner appears at top of Console > Endpoints and in API docs. Max headline length: ~60 chars; body ~140 chars.

Mia (Product Design): Proposed variants (feel free to edit):
```
A) Headline: Deprecated: Legacy endpoint v1.2 will be retired
   Body: This endpoint will stop accepting requests on 2026-05-22. Switch to v2 to avoid interruptions. Learn how →

B) Headline: v1.2 retirement scheduled
   Body: We will stop supporting v1.2 on 2026-05-22. Migrate to v2 for improved reliability and cost. Migration guide →

C) Headline: Action required: migrate from v1.2
   Body: v1.2 will be turned off on 2026-05-22. Update your clients to v2 before that date. See migration steps →
```

Alex (PM): :eyes: thanks Mia. Prefer concise headline + single-sentence body. Need explicit date and clear CTA. Also, can we surface an ETA for automated redirects (none planned).

Jordan (UX Writing): I like B for clarity but tweak tone — avoid ‘retire’ as it reads vague. Suggest: Headline: v1.2 deprecation scheduled — Body: v1.2 will be turned off on May 22, 2026. Update to v2 to avoid downtime. Migration guide →

Sam (Accessibility): Quick a11y notes: visible text should convey urgency but not alarm. Add a screen-reader-only announcement that includes the date and CTA label. Example SR text: "Notice: legacy endpoint v1.2 will be turned off on May 22, 2026. Press the Migration guide link to view steps." Ensure link has descriptive text (avoid generic ‘Learn more’).

Riley (Eng): Character limit note: banner area truncates at ~100 chars on small screens. Keep headline < 40 and body < 100 ideally. Also confirm whether the banner can link to a specific anchor (#migration) instead of docs root.

Lina (Localization): For i18n: avoid idioms like ‘turn off’. Use ‘will be disabled’ or ‘will stop accepting requests’ which are easier to translate. Also keep dates in YYYY-MM-DD for machine parsing in some locales, but human-friendly date (May 22, 2026) is fine if we include ISO date in aria-describedby or tooltip.

Jordan (UX Writing): Updated suggestion combining all feedback:
```
Headline: v1.2 deprecation scheduled
Body: v1.2 will stop accepting requests on May 22, 2026. Update to v2 to avoid downtime. Migration guide →
SR-only: Notice: legacy endpoint v1.2 will stop accepting requests on 2026-05-22. Migration guide opens in the documentation.
```

Mia (Product Design): Nice — compact and i18n-friendly. Riley: can we make Migration guide link text exactly "Migration guide (v1.2 → v2)" for clarity and a11y?

Riley (Eng): Yup, linking to /docs/endpoints/migration#v1-2 is possible. No redirect planned.

Sam (Accessibility): Final a11y checklist: 1) Banner role="status" for polite announcement? Prefer role="status" + aria-live="polite" so it doesn't interrupt. 2) Include aria-describedby pointing to a hidden element with ISO date. 3) Link text as proposed.

Lina (Localization): When you add the ISO date in a hidden id, please keep that id outside translatable strings (engineers can append it at render time).

Alex (PM): Decision: Use Jordan’s updated copy, link text as Riley suggested, SR text as Jordan drafted, and Sam’s aria approach. Add a one-line help tooltip on hover: "Why am I seeing this? — This endpoint is scheduled to be disabled; update to v2."

Mia (Product Design): Perfect. I’ll push the copy to the design token and hand off to eng. Thanks everyone! :rocket:

a11y-bot: Quick reminder — run accessibility smoke tests after deploy (focus order + announcement).
